brief:
US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee characterized Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank as "terror," Al Jazeera English reported. The statement represents a rare public condemnation of the settler movement by a senior American diplomat stationed in the country.

Huckabee's remarks signal friction over policy toward Israeli settlements, which are considered illegal under international law and a major obstacle to peace negotiations. The ambassador's comments are notable given his long history of support for pro-Israel advocacy groups and his previous positions within conservative American political circles.
dek: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee says Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank.
title: US ambassador to Israel condemns settler violence as terrorism
